Today's practice: back to the body.
[pause 64]
When worry pulls you into your head, your body is always here to come back to.
[pause 68]
Feel your hands. Their weight, their warmth.
[pause 68]
Feel your breath moving in your belly.
[pause 68]
This is the skill: notice you've drifted, and gently come back to sensation.
[pause 68]
